newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 6.

text.p: These are leading stories in today's afternoon daily Le Monde, dated March 7.

-- Paris mayor Jean Tiberi says he is under investigation as part of inquiry into 200,000-franc consultancy fee paid to wife Xaviere Tiberi, into couple's joint bank account. He condemned the affair as "legal harassment" and vowed to stay in office.
-- Vosges mushroom lovers contaminated by Cesium 137 from 1986 Chernobyl accident.
-- Civil servants on strike today over pay and loss of purchasing power.
-- Socialist Party internal report recommends overhaul and liberalisation of immigration laws.

-- Renault chairman Louis Schweitzer ready to negotiate lay-off benefits for Vilvoorde workers as Kia Motors expresses interest in taking over the plant and Belgian Financieel Economische Tidj suggests Chrysler may also bid for the plant.
